name: PocketPC Vulkan Continuous Present v52
purpose: Evolve the v51 one-shot diagnostic copy into a continuous, ownership-safe frame stream without allowing the Wine guest to overwrite the exported image while the Android host is consuming it.

compatibility.baseline: v51 remains the official one-shot path until v52 implementation and executed evidence exist.
compatibility.graphicsSession: PGH1 v1 remains the authenticated SOCK_SEQPACKET transport.
compatibility.resourceOffer: PGT1/PVI1 offer identity remains immutable for one resource generation.
compatibility.ownershipSemaphore: PVS1 role FRAME_OWNERSHIP is reused instead of inventing an unsynchronized second ownership channel.
compatibility.pga1: PGA1 stages 1-6 remain lifecycle/diagnostic acknowledgements; continuous frame ownership is not inferred from repeated PGA1 packets.
compatibility.jniNumericBoundary: Kotlin/JNI transport uses Long/jlong, so v52 intentionally stays within signed 64-bit positive values even though Vulkan timeline counters are uint64_t.

identity.offerSequenceMeaning: Immutable descriptor/FD-offer identity. It is not the continuous frame number.
identity.frameSequenceSource: Derived from the shared PVS1 timeline value.
identity.generationRule: Resize, resource recreation, device loss, incompatible format/extent, or timeline exhaustion creates a new generation and a fresh timeline initialized to zero.

timelineOwnership.overflowPolicy: Fail closed before multiplication/addition can exceed Long.MAX_VALUE/jlong positive range. Recreate the resource/generation instead of wrapping or crossing into negative Kotlin values.

guestPerFrameOrder: For frame 1, treat timeline value 0 as the initial host-consumed release. For frame N>1, wait until timeline >= hostConsumed(N-1).
Acquire the exported image from VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_EXTERNAL onto the exact Wine Present queue/device path.
Copy the exact presented swapchain VkImage into the exported image with explicit layouts/barriers and Present synchronization.
Release the exported image back to VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_EXTERNAL.
Signal PVS1 to guestReady(N) only after the copy and external release are ordered/completed.
Do not reacquire or overwrite the exported image for frame N+1 until hostConsumed(N) is observed.
hostPerFrameOrder: Wait until PVS1 >= guestReady(N), then require the observed timeline value to equal guestReady(N) exactly.
Reject a frame if resourceId/generation no longer match the active resource or if the derived frame sequence is stale/non-monotonic.
Acquire the exported image from external ownership on the Android Vulkan device used by the persistent host consumer.
Copy/read back the frame and publish it to the exact desktop window owner.
Signal PVS1 to hostConsumed(N) only after host consumption, external ownership return, and desktop-model delivery complete.
Do not promote model delivery to physical-visible evidence.
failClosedRules: Never write while the opposite side owns the image.
Never derive continuous frame number from the immutable PVI1 offer sequence.
Never reuse frameSequence after a generation change.
Never accept an even value as guest-ready or an odd value as host-consumed.
Never accept a lower or equal frame sequence after a newer frame was already committed for the same generation.
Never pass a timeline value greater than Long.MAX_VALUE through Kotlin/JNI.
Never advance to frame N+1 while hostConsumed(N) still has a pending signal.
Never recreate/import PVI1 and PVS1 for every frame in the proposed v52 native host path; keep one persistent native import per resource generation.
Never infer host-visible presentation from successful Vulkan readback or Compose model delivery.
Never infer Roblox execution, rendering, playability, input, audio, network, or stability from this contract.
